_README: Curated candidate manifest for Jamn's 'Vinyl Crate' — CC-BY / CC0 seed tracks. METADATA + DOWNLOAD URLS + LICENSE RECORDS ONLY: no audio was downloaded and no analysis was run. This is the human-reviewable input to the VPS ingestion pipeline. Every track was license-verified from the SOURCE's own authoritative metadata (ccMixter API license_url, Jamendo license via Openverse index, incompetech policy). All entries are attribution-only (CC-BY) or CC0 — NO NonCommercial, NO NoDerivatives, NO ShareAlike — so remixes/exports are unencumbered (export_encumbered=false for every row). REVIEW each row, then feed to ingestion.
generated_by: discovery+curation pass (Claude); no GPU, no prod access, no audio pulled
license_note: license_id records the ACTUAL CC version per track (accuracy is non-negotiable), not a normalized label. ccMixter and Jamendo are overwhelmingly CC-BY 3.0 (some 2.0/2.5); Kevin MacLeod is CC-BY 4.0. CC0 count is 0: clean, full-band, stem-separable CC0 contemporary music is genuinely scarce — see sourcing_caveats.
selection_criteria: Full-band arrangement (drums+bass+harmonic, usually vocals) so stem separation yields real stems; rejected solo/ambient/drone/spoken/field-recording.
Studio/stereo mix (ccMixter: required 'stereo' systag; Jamendo/KM: studio-produced).
Duration ~2:00-4:30 where the source exposes it (Jamendo & KM verified; ccMixter duration not in API -> verify at ingest).
Diversity across genre and tempo buckets (80-100 / 100-120 / 120-140 / 140-160 / 160+).

sources_used.ccMixter: dig/query API — https://ccmixter.org/api/query — backbone: real songs w/ vocals, exact BPM tags, verified pure CC-BY.
sources_used.Jamendo (via Openverse): Jamendo direct API needs a client_id we don't have (demo IDs suspended/rate-blocked); reached Jamendo tracks through the Openverse index which exposes each track's Jamendo license + download URL + genres. Genre diversity.
sources_used.incompetech / Kevin MacLeod: pieces.json catalog — studio-produced CC-BY-4.0 full-band instrumentals with exact BPM/instruments/ISRC; fills instrumental variety and precise tempo range.

api_queries_reproducible.ccMixter_filter: keep if license_url contains '/licenses/by/' and not nc/nd; systag 'stereo'; >=2 instrument usertag families incl a rhythm instr; has an mp3 file. NOTE limit>~15 returns empty; paginate via offset.
api_queries_reproducible.Openverse_filter: keep if license in {by,cc0} (EXCLUDES by-sa/nc/nd — note: license_type=commercial,modification alone does NOT drop ShareAlike), category=music, 120000<=duration_ms<=270000. speed_* tag used as approx tempo.
api_queries_reproducible.incompetech: GET https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/pieces.json ; keep instruments contain drums+bass+harmonic, length 2:00-4:30, exclude medieval/ambient/orchestral/solo feels. MP3 = https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/mp3-royaltyfree/<filename> (URL-encoded).
api_queries_reproducible.InternetArchive_probe: GET https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php?q=mediatype:audio AND collection:netlabels AND (licenseurl:*licenses/by/3* OR *by/4* OR *publicdomain/zero*)&sort=downloads desc — used only to assess; NOT included (see caveats).

download_notes.ccMixter: Server 403s bot User-Agents. Fetch with a browser UA + Referer, e.g. -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 ...' -H 'Referer: https://ccmixter.org/'. Verified: returns 206 audio/mpeg with those headers.
download_notes.Jamendo (Openverse url): download_url is the Jamendo storage stream (…storage.jamendo.com/?trackid=…&format=mp32); verified HTTP 200 audio/mpeg (follows one redirect). source_url is the human track page.
download_notes.incompetech: direct MP3 verified HTTP 200. source_url is the official filmmusic.io per-track page.

sourcing_caveats: Jamendo: no live-API key available (demo client_ids are suspended/rate-blocked). Jamendo metadata here comes via Openverse's index, which is authoritative for license+download but does NOT expose BPM and only surfaced the 'speed_medium' tag — so the 14 Jamendo rows carry APPROX mid-tempo (~100-120), not exact BPM. Precise tempo spread is carried by the ccMixter + Kevin MacLeod rows (exact BPM). If exact Jamendo BPM/mood is wanted, get a Jamendo API key and re-pull (their API returns bpm + tags + audiodownload).

Internet Archive EXCLUDED: its licenseurl field is user-supplied and frequently FALSE — 'CC0' hits included pirated commercial masters (AC/DC 'Highway to Hell', ONE OK ROCK, Joji 'Nectar'). Not safe to trust at face value for a legally-clean crate. Could be revisited but only per-item hand-verified against a trustworthy uploader (e.g. netlabel/artist self-release).

Musopen (CC0 classical) EXCLUDED: items are 50+ min multi-movement 'premix' L/R splits, not clean 2-4min stereo songs, AND classical separates poorly under a drums/bass/vocals/other stem model (no drums/bass/vox -> nearly all 'other'). Poor fit for the crate despite clean CC0.

CC0 coverage is 0. The trustworthy CC-attribution music ecosystem (ccMixter, Jamendo, Kevin MacLeod) is essentially CC-BY, not CC0. Getting real CC0 full-band tracks would need per-item vetted IA netlabel picks or a dedicated CC0 label — deferred.

ccMixter duration is not in the API; the ~2:00-4:30 criterion is unverified for those 20 rows (verify at ingest). Some ccMixter 'remix'-culture tracks are built by layering an a-cappella over a backing track — that actually stem-separates cleanly (real vocal + instrumental stems).

Quality is candidate-level, not ear-verified: no audio was auditioned. ccMixter picks are rank/score-sorted (community-vetted) and Kevin MacLeod is reliably studio-grade; a few Jamendo/ccMixter rows may be weaker and should be dropped on listen at review.
